aria.subtitle: Official Angular ARIA patterns — Accordion · Tabs · Listbox · Live regions

accordion.a1: Signals are reactive primitives that Angular uses to track dependencies and update the DOM efficiently. They replace zone.js for change detection.
accordion.q2: When to use computed() vs effect()?
accordion.a2: Use computed() to derive values from signals — it memoizes and re-runs only when its dependencies change. Use effect() only for side effects like logging, DOM manipulation, or analytics.
accordion.a3: Angular 17+ makes standalone the default. Components declare their own imports array, eliminating the need for NgModules.

tabs.wcagContent: WCAG AA requires a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Angular templates should use semantic HTML and provide sufficient color contrast.
tabs.keyboardContent: All interactive elements must be keyboard accessible. Use tabindex, focus management, and ARIA roles to ensure users can navigate without a mouse.
tabs.screenContent: Angular applications should announce dynamic content changes with aria-live regions. Use aria-label, aria-labelledby, and aria-describedby to provide context.

aria.liveDesc: aria-live announces dynamic content to screen readers. Use polite for non-critical updates, assertive for errors.
